text:
olivia_sales: Heads up — ACME wants a bundled quote: API + Optimize + Console add-on, per-seat for Console, 12mo commit. Asking for 30% off list across bundle. Need deal desk sign-off and POC dates. Details: expected $500k ARR, 150 seats first year. Any blockers?
aj_pricing: Can you share expected committed ARR number? 30% sounds high; what's current list for each line?
pete_se: POC timeline: we can spin up API + Optimize next week. Console per-seat access + SSO will take ~2 weeks. Need VPC details if they want private hosting.
olivia_sales: Committed ARR ~ $500k (customer confirmed). Per-seat = $30/mo list -> ~ $54k ARR from seats; rest token usage ~ $446k. So bundle discount request would cut deeply into unit economics.
aj_pricing: Need margin calc. At 30% off blended, finance sign-off required. Suggest alternate: 15% flat or tiered discount with commit. Also propose a minimum net revenue floor.
drew_finance: We need net revenue floor >= $420k to hit targets. 30% off likely drops us below. Recommend max 20% if they do 12mo commit and prepay.
liam_legal: If we do per-seat billing, we need a seat-addendum + SLA language. Also security questionnaire outstanding — can't finalize without SOC2 attestation confirmation for Console hosting mode.
sarah_csm: I'll run the security questionnaire with ACME tomorrow; they prefer VPC deployment. That will affect timeline and cost.
maya_product: Console features in VPC mode require extra infra work — engineering estimate is +$10k one-time setup. Flagging for pricing and SOW.
deal-desk-bot: Created ticket DD-4521 for approval. Assigned: @aj_pricing, @drew_finance. Attach ratecard: https://redwood.co/ratecard_v4.xlsx
aj_pricing: For the approval form propose: 18% discount on API list, 25% on Optimize, per-seat Console discount 10% plus 1-month waived onboarding fee. Conditions: $500k ARR commit, prepay quarterly, $420k net revenue floor. Anyone object?
olivia_sales: :thumbsup: I'll present that to the buyer. They want to close by EOW — can we get expedited deal-desk sign-off?
drew_finance: I can provisionally approve if they prepay and we get the $420k floor. Final approval after legal signs the SOW.
liam_legal: I'll draft SOW with VPC clause and SOC2 reference, ETA 48h. Will add per-seat billing appendix.
pete_se: POC kickoff tentatively Mon 3/30. Need SSO metadata and VPC peering info from ACME to schedule.
sarah_csm: Adding to my calendar, will send security contact and follow-ups after the questionnaire call.
deal-desk-bot: DD-4521 status: Pending approver signatures: @drew_finance. Reminder sent.
olivia_sales: Thanks team — will update buyer and loop back in AM. Filing this thread in sales ops.
